Title: imperative, under 70 characters.

Issue linkage is deterministic: use GitHub closing keywords, one issue per
line, exactly as written below. "Closes #N" / "Fixes #N" auto-close the
issue when this PR merges INTO THE DEFAULT BRANCH (main). PRs that target
an integration branch (e.g. v3-build) cannot auto-close issues no matter
the wording — use "Closes #N" anyway so the intent is explicit and the
final integration-branch → main PR restates every "Closes #N" line so the
single merge to main closes them all.

Never use vague linkage ("implements", "part of", "addresses") as the
only reference to an issue this PR completes.
-->
